reviewerRole: Independent synthetic experienced HM high-base user, not specialist coach or human athlete
scope: All 14 old and all 14 new baseline weeks; production execution event; separate earlier controlled event. No UI claims.

primaryEvent.exactError: Preostalo vreme ne podržava novi pun ciklus: Manje od 10 nedelja do trke (minimum za polumaraton) — puna periodizacija nije moguća. Datum trke nije automatski pomeren.

findings.expected: Experienced HM runner with 55 km/week, 24 consistent weeks and current PB should receive a clearly justified useful threshold dose. No universal minimum asserted.
findings.actual: W1 2x1000 m + 2x700 m T = 3.4 km / 14.90 min; W2 2x1000 m + 1.7 km continuous T = 3.7 km / 16.22 min. Both weeks use two quality slots and 6.5 km warm-up/cool-down per session. Athlete is correctly classified experienced.
findings.significance: HM-oriented choice is improved over early R work, but two very small doses may spend recovery/calendar slots with less adaptation than one coherent threshold session. Independent user assessment; not a proven physiological failure.

findings.expected: Assess whether HM RP repetitions form a sustained race-specific stimulus; profile code describes short jog recoveries. Recovery length should reflect purpose.
findings.actual: New 2x2500 m at 4:30/km with 284 s recovery: each block 675 s, recovery 42.1% of work. Old 2x3000 m with same recovery. New W9/W11 finish adds 5.5 km at RP; this compensates partly for short standalone RP dose.
findings.significance: Not automatically inadequate. Experienced runner could benefit from shorter jogs or longer controlled blocks, but race-specific long-run finishes and 10 km rehearsal already supply useful continuity.

findings.expected: Distinguish measured PB equivalence from speculative future improvement; no confirmed future fitness gain exists in this input.
findings.actual: VDOT rises deterministically 48.2 to 51.2; predictedSec=5383 (1:29:43). New uses VDOT 48.2 unchanged and reference 5672 (1:34:32). Difference 289 seconds.
findings.significance: Old reference can imply a roughly five-minute fitness improvement without supporting execution/results. New assessmentBasis=current-fitness and reference-only preparation address this baseline concern.

findings.expected: Informational duration should track displayed distance and easy pace after volume trimming.
findings.actual: W8 16.1 km at displayed 5:24/km is 86.94 min (~87), text says 93 min; W12 17.2 km is 92.88 min (~93), text says 99 min. Both have no fast finish.
findings.significance: Small but reproducible numeric/text mismatch affects planning time and fuel guidance. New respective durations are consistent.

findings.expected: An intentionally near-race-pace activation should have a matching kind/zone/source, or explicit distinction from current-fitness R work; changing to true R pace is not required.
findings.actual: 6x200 m at 266 s/km (4:26), zone R, kind Repeticije, paceSource=current-fitness. Current-fitness R from VDOT 48.2 is 228 s/km (3:48); T is 263 s/km. Builder intentionally chooses racePace-4, but final description loses the activation qualifier.
findings.significance: Semantic classification and presented purpose conflict. Session may be reasonable activation, but should not be analyzed or communicated as actual R-pace work.

findings.expected: Confirmed 14-day-return initial three calendar weeks without quality should remove stride instructions from both structured fields and the visible description.
findings.actual: strides=null and no session/finish, but all three descriptions still contain + 6x20 s ubrzanja. Example 2026-10-30: 5.9 km lako ... + 6x20 s ubrzanja.
findings.significance: Reproducible instruction contradiction: visible text asks for fast strides while policy/model removes them. This occurs only in separate permitted 2026-10-28 simulation; primary 2026-11-25 event returns no plan.

findings.expected: Recompute weekly focus after return adjustment converts every planned quality session to easy running.
findings.actual: W4 and W5 focus remains Fartlek, with zero sessions/finishes, zero work minutes and all future runs easy.
findings.significance: Heading misrepresents week purpose despite coherent day/session arithmetic.

findings.expected: User-facing return summary and warnings should give the same number of initial easy weeks after policy is applied.
findings.actual: One warning says plan starts with 1 lagane povratne nedelje; adjustment note says 3 pocetne nedelje bez kvalitetnog rada. Final prescription follows the latter three calendar weeks.
findings.significance: Conflicting policy explanations can confuse when faster work resumes. Does not prove the actual easy-week guard failed.

overallAssessment: New is more credible about fitness and starts endurance from reported base, with better HM threshold emphasis. Early experienced-runner quality dose remains a coaching concern. Primary confirmed return safely refuses an undersized full cycle; permitted supplemental return retains visible text/focus/warning contradictions.
